title: Bide: the sleeper grows behind a wall
watch: The Dormouse waits and grows +1/+1 each time its turn comes while the Warden and the Calf hold. When they fall, it wakes and attacks big.
note: Grey Heron isn't built: Hazel Dormouse (Bide) stands in at B2. Bison Calf isn't built: a 2/10 filler unit, with no screen. The enemy is one 5/60 attacker.
